description: MCP server exposing LS증권 OpenAPI (REST) as tools. Read-only Korean stock market data and analysis via natural language.
releaseNotes: v1.0.0 — first stable release. The MCP tool surface (32 standard / 35 all), model-facing parameter names, and default response shapes are now frozen, with reflection-based pin tests guarding them. BREAKING: completes the row-cap normalization — ls_get_etf_holdings and ls_get_industry_indices rename top_n to limit, so every list/screener tool now uses limit. Also ships MCP server-instructions tool-routing guidance, routes personal-holdings questions to the local portfolio instead of refusing, and adds NuGet MCP environment metadata for LS credentials. See https://github.com/redoxnet/mcp-lsopenapi/blob/main/RELEASENOTES.Mcp.md.
